definitions.explanation: A pattern of stripes running vertically (top to bottom). Common in clothing and fabric design.

examples.japanese: {縦縞|たてじま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}ている→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: He's wearing a vertically striped shirt.

examples.japanese: {縦縞|たてじま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{柄|がら}→柄：02609_gara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{細|ほそ}く→細い：02962_hosoi⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: A vertical stripe pattern has the effect of making the body look slimmer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紺|こん}→紺：03885_kon⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縦縞|たてじま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ネクタイ→ネクタイ：01040_nekutai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I chose a navy and white vertically striped tie.

notes:
{縦縞|たてじま} is a pattern of stripes running vertically, commonly seen in clothing, fabric, and design.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{縦|たて}→縦：17236_tate⟧ (vertical) + ⟦{縞|しま}→縞：27905_shima⟧ (stripes).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縦縞|たてじま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧: vertically striped shirt
- {縦縞|たてじま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{柄|がら}→柄：02609_gara⟧: vertical stripe pattern
- {縦縞|たてじま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ユニフォーム: pinstriped uniform

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {縦縞|たてじま}: vertical stripes
- ⟦{横縞|よこじま}→横縞：18812_yokojima⟧: horizontal stripes
- ⟦ストライプ→ストライプ：27546_sutoraipu⟧: stripes (loanword, used in fashion contexts for either direction)

FASHION NOTE:
{縦縞|たてじま} is widely believed to have a slimming visual effect. In baseball, pinstriped uniforms ({縦縞|たてじま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ユニフォーム) are iconic, particularly associated with certain professional teams.
